short_description_zh: 明代成化八年状元，官至礼部尚书。诗文宗苏轼，书法开吴门书派先河。与沈周为挚友，文徵明之师。著有《匏翁家藏集》。
short_description_en: Ming dynasty zhuangyuan (top jinshi) of 1472, rose to Minister of Rites. Poet and calligrapher who modeled his style on Su Shi and laid foundations for the Wu School of Calligraphy. Close friend of Shen Zhou, teacher of Wen Zhengming. Author of Collected Works of Paoweng.
